messages:
Marco Rivera: quick sync pls — PRD draft attached for a narrower scope to ship rerank+embeddings gating for high-volume customers. thinking: 1) explicit rate cutoff + fallback model route, 2) opt-in embeddings caching, 3) new acceptance criteria for end-to-end latency under burst
Priya Patel: skimmed. can we make the gating per-customer policy-based (tier + SLA) rather than global? less blast radius for customers on Dedicated
Samir Kapoor: +1 on policy. tradeoff is complexity in routing. need to know if runtime routing will accept per-customer rules or if we fold into a single tiered route table
Alice Chen: devex concerns: SDK surface — we should add a flag in client config, not require callers to toggle headers. recommend `client.config.features.rerank_gating`
Lidia Gomez: from PM side, also add launch criteria: 95th perc latency < 600ms for sample workload, canary to 5% accounts, rollback on >1.5x error rate vs baseline
Marco Rivera: wrote a compact acceptance checklist in the PRD:
```
- canary rollout (5%) passes latency & error gating for 48h
- fallback route triggered and logged for all gated requests
- metric: tokens/sec per customer tracked hourly
- gated customers see <5% change in output quality on eval set
```
Priya Patel: edge cases we must call out:
- model fallback may change tokenization -> embeddings drift -> downstream similarity mismatch
- partial responses when KV cache warmed vs cold (inconsistent rerank inputs)
- concurrent requests during surge might get mixed routing decisions
We should add automated test harness for these
Samir Kapoor: engineering notes: runtime changes needed: policy table, per-request annotation, fallback queue. rough timeline: 2 sprint infra work + 1 sprint ml integration + 1 sprint testing/rollout
Alice Chen: SDK plan: expose opt-in boolean + telemetry tag. example: `redwood = RedwoodClient({features:{rerank_gating:true}})` and auto-send `x-rw-gated:true` header when routed
Lidia Gomez: commercial asks: two customers pushed for opt-in this quarter. if we deprioritize, risk conversion. we should consider shipping minimal beta (no per-customer policies) to Hosted tier first, then expand to Dedicated
Marco Rivera: proposal: ship MVP Hosted-only with global gating and simple fallback (cheaper model), measure ops impact, then iterate per-customer policy for Dedicated. That reduces infra scope to 2 sprints instead of 4
Priya Patel: acceptance criteria for MVP Hosted-only:
- gated requests rerouted to cheaper model with same API contract
- metrics surfaced in Console: gated-rate, fallback-rate, avg-latency-by-route
- eval-suite: quality regression <7% on top-k rerank metric
Samir Kapoor: agree but callout: cheaper model must be quantized and validated for hallucination regressions. ML needs 1 sprint for eval set prep
deploy-bot: deploy plan updated: canary tag `rerank-gating-v1` created. automatic rollback hook set on error_rate > 1.5x baseline for 2h
Lidia Gomez: next steps: Marco to update PRD with MVP scope + rollout plan, Samir to validate infra estimate, Priya to draft eval tests, Alice to add SDK proposal. sync Thurs 10am
Marco Rivera: assigning now — thanks all. will drop link to PRD in thread shortly :thumbsup:
